title: Prompt engineering in LLMs for automated unit test generation: A large-scale study
datasets: Defects4J token-filtered 477 classes / 16 projects; SF110 182 classes; CMD 31 classes, 2 post-May-2023 repos. Final paper does not perform fault detection or mutation.
models: GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4, Mistral 7B, Mixtral 8x7B; GPT-4/Mixtral only CMD. Temperature .7, 30 runs.
license: Anonymous artifact MIT (snapshot 2024-09); final author accepted manuscript CC BY 4.0.
input_setting: Full Java class; 5 prompt strategies; metrics extraction/syntax/compilation/readability/smells/coverage. No F2P pairs in final 2026 paper.
reproduction_grade: No exact 2026 reproduction: linked public package is a 2024 snapshot, visible tree incomplete vs paper README, versions not matched.
concept_hook: Class-level prompt study, output extraction, hallucination/compilation and maintainability analysis.
limitation: Explicitly no buggy/fixed F2P, exception fault detection, or mutation in final paper; internal contradictory prose about mutation. Old artifact mismatch, no Qwen.
